lockState.searchScope: the full recursive git tree at the pinned revision (537 blobs)
lockState.declaredRangeStyle: tilde ranges for most direct dependencies, caret ranges for a minority; .npmrc sets save-prefix='~'
lockState.resolutionsFieldNote: package.json carries a yarn-style `resolutions` block pinning moment to 2.24.0. npm 6 ignores `resolutions`, so it had no effect on the npm baseline install recorded here.
lockState.consequence: There is no upstream pin. Any install resolves the declared ranges against the registry as it exists at install time, so the closure is not reproducible from the repository alone.

observedResolution.what: The lockfile npm 6.13.4 generated during this unit's baseline install in the declared cell. It is a record of what the ranges resolved to on 2026-08-10, not an upstream artifact, and it is not published into the repository.
observedResolution.sha256Caveat: This digest was taken after the baseline install and after the single deviation pin of @types/babel__traverse@7.0.15 described in baseline-attempt.json, so it is a snapshot of the cell at the end of this unit rather than of the baseline install alone.

integrity.note: Every entry in the generated lockfile carries a sha512 integrity hash, because it was generated today rather than in 2020. This is a property of this unit's resolution, not evidence about the upstream repository.

drift.description: Unpinned ranges resolved to present-day releases of transitive @types packages whose declaration files use TypeScript syntax that postdates the typescript ~3.8.3 the repository pins. Two independent instances were hit in sequence during the baseline and its one deviation.

instances.declarationSyntax: key remapping in mapped types (`[N in Node as N["type"]]`), TypeScript 4.1 and later
template-literal type with `infer ... extends` (`` `${infer N extends number}` ``), TypeScript 4.7 and later

drift.unknownPreserved: Only two drifted packages were reached before this unit stopped iterating. Whether the remaining closure would typecheck under typescript 3.8.3 once every @types package is era-pinned is unknown and is not claimed either way.

nonclaims: Per-artifact byte digests were not independently mirrored in this unit; the recorded integrity hashes are the ones the generated lockfile declares.
A resolvable closure establishes no build, browser behavior, licence compatibility of transitive dependencies, migration feasibility, or production readiness.
The generated lockfile is not offered as a reconstruction of the 2020 closure. It is the resolution this cell produced today, and it is recorded as such.
